name: personal-cfo
description: A public-safe starter repository for a local-first personal finance assistant focused on cash-flow clarity and consumer-debt reduction.

scripts.dev: env -u TMP -u TEMP -u TMPDIR next dev
scripts.build: env -u TMP -u TEMP -u TMPDIR next build --webpack
scripts.start: env -u TMP -u TEMP -u TMPDIR next start
scripts.test: env -u TMP -u TEMP -u TMPDIR vitest run
scripts.db:generate: env -u TMP -u TEMP -u TMPDIR drizzle-kit generate
scripts.db:migrate: env -u TMP -u TEMP -u TMPDIR drizzle-kit migrate
scripts.demo:reset: env -u TMP -u TEMP -u TMPDIR node --import tsx src/db/reset.ts
scripts.demo:generate-briefs: env -u TMP -u TEMP -u TMPDIR node --env-file-if-exists=.env.local --conditions=react-server --import tsx src/server/generate-demo-narratives.ts
